text:
alice.dev: Heads-up — Support just escalated an outage from a customer, reproducible with the Go SDK v0.12.x. 401s + retry loops, causing a billing spike. Ticket INC-4321.
ben.support: Customer says it started after the latest client regen last week. They upgraded SDK and started seeing 401 followed by immediate retry flood.
carla.sdk: Oof. Which regen PR? Any changelog notes?
alice.dev: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-gen/pull/782 — commit bumped openapi schema and bumped go-client minor version. No changelog entry about header normalization.
ben.support: Error sample from customer: 
```
POST /v1/generate 401 Unauthorized
Authorization: Bearer <token>
x-client-id: "my-app"

Response: {
  "error": "invalid_token"
}
```
carla.sdk: Hmm token valid but header order/quoting looked weird in their dump. Go client started emitting `Authorization` and `authorization` both in some code paths after regen. That could confuse our auth middleware/gateway which dedupes then drops one.
elaine.eng: We also saw retries in gateway because the client returned 5xx in our staging for the same pattern — retry policy engaged. If token dropped then backend returns 401 which some SDKs translate to retry when wrapped by certain HTTP clients.
frank.release: david-ci-bot, did the CI regen job update go.mod/go.sum in the mono-repo? Could be lockfile drift across CI images.
david-ci-bot: ci: openapi-generator ran on 1798680000 image. It updated generated clients and pushed `go-client@v0.12.4` and `python-client@1.3.0`. No additional integration tests failed at that time.
carla.sdk: We're missing a cross-SDK integration test that validates header normalization and idempotent auth behavior. We should add one.
alice.dev: Repro steps from Support (sanitized):
1) install go-client v0.12.4
2) call Generate with API key in env var
3) run under k8s service account, observe 401 then heavy retries
4) curl the gateway with same token succeeds

carla.sdk: Possible root cause: OpenAPI patch introduced optional header `x-client-id` that our generator represented with `omitempty` and a pointer, generator duplicated Authorization header in custom transport wrapper.
ben.support: Customer logs show retry headers: `X-Retry-After: 0`, repeated 6 times per second. Billing spiked. They want immediate mitigation.
frank.release: Mitigation options: 1) rollback go-client to v0.12.3 for now 2) hotfix patch to generator to stop duplicate headers and release 0.12.5 3) gateway guard to dedupe/normalize headers and treat duplicate Authorization as single.
elaine.eng: Gateway change is safest long-term but takes time. Hotfix release of Go client + patch to CI to pin previously known-good generator image is fastest.
carla.sdk: I'll open a minimal PR to remove duplicate Authorization behavior in the transport wrapper and add a test: `TestTransportDoesNotDuplicateAuthHeader`. Also will add a cross-sdk smoke test that calls a protected endpoint with token and asserts single Authorization header.
alice.dev: Can you include repro snippet and customer logs in PR description? Support needs ETA to tell customer.
carla.sdk: Yup. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-gen/pull/789 (WIP). Expect draft by EOD.
david-ci-bot: Note: CI flaky job `regen-smoke-cross-sdk` currently not run on regen-only changes. Suggest flip to run on generator-image changes.
ben.support: Customer reply: thanks, they need rollback or whitelist on billing while we fix. Escalated to finance for temporary credit.
frank.release: I'll coordinate rollback release if Carla's patch won't be ready in 2 hours. We can cut a 0.12.3-patch rollback and patch the release notes.
elaine.eng: Also adding a lightweight canary: route 5% of requests to a header-normalizing proxy for 24h. Action item for infra team.
carla.sdk: Follow-ups I will add to PR: changelog entry, test, and a note to pin generator image in `regen-ci.yml`.
alice.dev: Great. For the thread: assign INC-4321, link PR 789, and mark customer impacted.
ben.support: @carla.sdk please ping when PR is draft. Support will push rollback ask to customer meanwhile. :thumbsup:
carla.sdk: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
